source.method: Headless Playwright Chromium capture of the live public .attention-device element
source.data_boundary: The public demo uses synthetic OpenEMR data. These captures do not show customer data.

captures.state: Initial public identity request before an operator action; the retained OpenEMR evidence image completed with nonzero natural dimensions before capture
Public runner result after the permitted Check identity action

sequence: Wait until the retained OpenEMR evidence image is visible, complete, and has nonzero natural width and height.
Capture the .attention-device element in its initial identity-request state.
Select the permitted Check identity action.
Wait for the Identity verified runner receipt.
